entities.name: Mehmet Yılmaz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mehmet Yılmaz is a Turkish weightlifter who competed in the –77 kg division. He represented Turkey at the 1996 Summer Olympics and 2000 Summer Olympics, and was a multiple medalist at the World Weightlifting Championships, European Weightlifting Championships, and Mediterranean Games.
